snippet.title: HOTEL BARCELONA – Xbox Launch Trailer | Coming September 26, 2025
snippet.description:
From cult legends SWERY (Deadly Premonition, D4: Dark Dreams Don’t Die) and SUDA51 (No More Heroes, Lollipop Chainsaw), step inside the most twisted holiday you’ll ever take.

Welcome to HOTEL BARCELONA – a surreal, blood-drenched sidescrolling roguelite where you fight, die, repeat, and hunt down the Seven Slasher Killers haunting the halls.

A rookie marshal – possessed by a psychopath.
America’s deadliest murderers – under one cursed roof.
Your mission? CHECK IN. WIPE ‘EM OUT.

Xbox. September 26, 2025.
